name: megascenes-graduation-invitation
description: Design graduation party invitations with the graduate's name, the class or degree, the date, the time and the place on them, in the colors you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give the graduate's name, the class or degree and the party details you want printed, and pick the look: black and gold, navy and white, modern minimal, confetti and caps. You get an invitation with your words set in the design, portrait to print, tall to send from your phone, or square.

ChatGPT tells you what the invitation needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The invitation opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the invitation: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For graduates and families getting ready for a graduation party, from high school to a master's degree.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. School crests and logos are not drawn. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name, class and party details in the design
Return the invitation in the chat
defaultPrompt: A black and gold graduation party invitation for Sofia, Class of 2027
A navy and white invitation for Marco's graduation party, Saturday at 6 pm
A confetti and caps invitation for Elena's Master in Design celebration

positive.prompt: A black and gold graduation party invitation for Sofia, Class of 2027, Saturday 19 June at 6 pm. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one graduation invitation needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A navy and white invitation for Marco's graduation party, Saturday at 6 pm. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one invitation needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a graduation invitation here?
positive.expected_behavior: The graduation invitation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A modern minimal graduation party invitation for Elena, Master in Design, Sunday 27 June at 5 pm, tall to send from my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my invitation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my invitation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
